name: Nai Mong Hoi Tod
description: A small Chinatown shop on Michelin's 2026 Bib Gourmand list, known for crispy oyster omelette and mussel omelette.
review_body: A small shop on Soi Phlap Phla Chai in Chinatown, on Michelin's 2026 Bib Gourmand list. It's known for crispy oyster omelette (hoi tod) and mussel omelette.
